summary: End-to-end testing of Catellon Septic Services MVP. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed covering availability config, slots, bookings (incl. 409 conflict + emergency override), quotes, auth (success/failure), admin auth gating, list/patch/delete on bookings & quotes, and availability persistence. Frontend: Landing page renders hero, 4 service cards, floating CTAs; /quote form submits successfully; /book 4-step wizard completes end-to-end (service -> date -> slot -> info -> confirmation); /admin/login authenticates and redirects to dashboard with all 3 tabs (Bookings Calendar, Quote Requests, Availability) visible and availability form rendered with save button. All critical flows working.

issues: Console shows 401 errors on initial page load due to /api/auth/me being called pre-login (expected, but produces noisy console). Consider suppressing the error toast/log when there's no token yet.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True. This combination is rejected by browsers per CORS spec. Currently works because the preview origin is wildcarded; for production set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly.
Auth: cookie sets secure=False. Acceptable for preview (http via ingress) but should be True in prod and SameSite=None for cross-site usage.
No brute force / login lockout protection on /api/auth/login (the playbook recommends 5-attempt lockout). Not blocking, but recommended.
/api/auth/me requires admin role — fine, but returns 401 quietly on every public page mount (App-level auth bootstrap). Consider gating the call to admin routes only.
Booking conflict check uses non-cancelled filter — good. But there is no concurrency lock; two simultaneous posts could both pass. Low risk for this scale.
Quote validation: no max-length on message — minor.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed bookings and quotes and clean them up via admin DELETE endpoints. Final cleanup script ran successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for full backend regression. Frontend selectors: Book.jsx uses step-1-next/step-2-next (not -continue), input-name/phone/email/address/city/notes inside step 3. Step 4 uses data-testid='step-4'. Admin dashboard tabs: tab-calendar/tab-quotes/tab-settings.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features functioning correctly on first integrated test.
